sources.title: Grainstorm - The Ultimate Sound Design Tool
sources.snippet: GrainStorm is our flagship tool for exploring the creative frontiers of sample-based granular synthesis and advanced sampling techniques. Built for musicians, producers, and sound designers, it's equally at home in live performances, detailed sound design, sample editing, and even remastering workflows.
